units.rawText: Kurisu-chan, look! Those buildings are just up ahead!
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan, look! Those buildings are just up ahead!

spans.text: Kurisu-chan, look! Those buildings are just up ahead!

units.rawText: If we can just get over this wall...
units.displayText: If we can just get over this wall...

spans.text: If we can just get over this wall...

units.rawText: Am I imagining things? Kurisu-chan's body seems to have gotten lighter.
units.displayText: Am I imagining things? Kurisu-chan's body seems to have gotten lighter.

spans.text: Am I imagining things? Kurisu-chan's body seems to have gotten lighter.

units.rawText: I slowly realize I can't feel Kurisu-chan's body heat, so I hold her tighter, but then I see her body starting to turn transparent.
units.displayText: I slowly realize I can't feel Kurisu-chan's body heat, so I hold her tighter, but then I see her body starting to turn transparent.

spans.text: I slowly realize I can't feel Kurisu-chan's body heat, so I hold her tighter, but then I see her body starting to turn transparent.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan...
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan...

spans.text: Kurisu-chan...

units.rawText: I stop and gently lay her on my knees.
units.displayText: I stop and gently lay her on my knees.

spans.text: I stop and gently lay her on my knees.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan's eyes are tightly shut, and her hands and feet seem to be slowly disappearing.
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan's eyes are tightly shut, and her hands and feet seem to be slowly disappearing.

spans.text: Kurisu-chan's eyes are tightly shut, and her hands and feet seem to be slowly disappearing.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...

spans.text: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...

units.rawText: (Sniffle) Kurisu-chan... Don't go...
units.displayText: (Sniffle) Kurisu-chan... Don't go...

spans.text: (Sniffle) Kurisu-chan... Don't go...

units.rawText: I hug Kurisu-chan tightly, as though it can stop her from vanishing. My tears pass through Kurisu-chan's body and splash onto the ground.
units.displayText: I hug Kurisu-chan tightly, as though it can stop her from vanishing. My tears pass through Kurisu-chan's body and splash onto the ground.

spans.text: I hug Kurisu-chan tightly, as though it can stop her from vanishing. My tears pass through Kurisu-chan's body and splash onto the ground.

units.rawText: But Kurisu-chan still vanishes in the end, without a sound or anything remaining of her.
units.displayText: But Kurisu-chan still vanishes in the end, without a sound or anything remaining of her.

spans.text: But Kurisu-chan still vanishes in the end, without a sound or anything remaining of her.

units.rawText: Please, don't...
units.displayText: Please, don't...

spans.text: Please, don't...

units.rawText: My arms are empty. It's as though nothing was ever there.
units.displayText: My arms are empty. It's as though nothing was ever there.

spans.text: My arms are empty. It's as though nothing was ever there.

units.rawText: No...
units.displayText: No...

spans.text: No...

units.rawText: There's nobody around me now. Kurisu-chan is gone. The Upas are gone. Even those robots are gone.
units.displayText: There's nobody around me now. Kurisu-chan is gone. The Upas are gone. Even those robots are gone.

spans.text: There's nobody around me now. Kurisu-chan is gone. The Upas are gone. Even those robots are gone.

units.rawText: I get up shakily.
units.displayText: I get up shakily.

spans.text: I get up shakily.

units.rawText: ...Okarin, I'm sure Okarin can fix this. That's because he's Hououin Kyouma. He can do it.
units.displayText: ...Okarin, I'm sure Okarin can fix this. That's because he's Hououin Kyouma. He can do it.

spans.text: ...Okarin, I'm sure Okarin can fix this. That's because he's Hououin Kyouma. He can do it.

units.rawText: Everyone should be in the lab... That's right, Kurisu-chan should be there too, right? Mayushii was too slow, so Kurisu-chan went back there first... I'm sure that's it.
units.displayText: Everyone should be in the lab... That's right, Kurisu-chan should be there too, right? Mayushii was too slow, so Kurisu-chan went back there first... I'm sure that's it.

spans.text: Everyone should be in the lab... That's right, Kurisu-chan should be there too, right? Mayushii was too slow, so Kurisu-chan went back there first... I'm sure that's it.

units.rawText: Everyone must be so worried... It's all Mayushii's fault for being slow and even losing the fried chicken for everyone...
units.displayText: Everyone must be so worried... It's all Mayushii's fault for being slow and even losing the fried chicken for everyone...

spans.text: Everyone must be so worried... It's all Mayushii's fault for being slow and even losing the fried chicken for everyone...

units.rawText: Mayushii hopes they're not mad...
units.displayText: Mayushii hopes they're not mad...

spans.text: Mayushii hopes they're not mad...

units.rawText: Let's go back to <color=orange>the lab...</color>
units.displayText: Let's go back to the lab...

spans.text: Let's go back to
the lab...
